decisive_spans.text: Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed enhancement confined to the peripheral rim of the mass, with no satellite lesions identified

response.rationale: D10 is supported by the MRI findings of a 1.5 cm intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau and peripheral rim enhancement with no satellite lesions. D8 is contradicted by the absence of satellite lesions, which are often seen in synovial chondromatosis.
